limits: These are actual Unity-rendered stills, not screenshots of a live animation sequence. CharacterMotion root translation, tilt, hit timing, cross-sheet transitions, battlefield occlusion and reduced VFX were not exercised here.

velvetNativeComparison.method: Read-only RGBA measurement. Human-selected face-only ROIs; largest8connected peach skin component with RGB thresholds r>=150,g>=105,b>=65,r-g>=8,g-b>=8,alpha>128. Excludes separate collar/ear highlights. Face-skin extent is a proxy, not complete skull anatomy. Sole is lowest strong pixel of source front figure. Bottom20px toe runs are angle-dependent support widths, not anatomical foot lengths. No raster edited.
